_about: Meta rejects a body that starts or ends with a variable ({{1}}), so every body starts and ends with fixed text. Templates to submit to Meta once per client (WhatsApp Manager or submit-templates.mjs). {{BUSINESS}} is replaced by the business name before submitting. Utility = reminders about an existing booking (no offers inside, or Meta re-classifies as marketing). Marketing = come-back invites, only to people who agreed to offers.
